newsitem.title: USA: U.S. domestic crude grades weak, outrights advance.
newsitem.headline: U.S. domestic crude grades weak, outrights advance.

text.p: U.S. cash crude prices remained slightly weaker for domestic grades Thursday afternoon, fluctuating in spotty action for May barrels.
Traders said there was only modest interest in moving barrels ahead of pipeline scheduling day on Friday.

Cash crude markets have been thrown off normal course by confirmation that more than 2.7 million barrels of foreign crude was delivered against the May NYMEX contract, an unusual situation for the U.S. crude sector.
May West Texas Intermediate/Cushing was around flat to 10 cents over the June, though numbers were moving at will.
